proposals.title: Sommelier v10: PoA power floor, cork authority, Gravity security fix
proposals.summary: Upgrade to v10 at height 27425000. Adds x/poa authority power floor. BREAKING: validator cork scheduling is removed, replaced by a gov-controlled cork_authority. Fixes Gravity GHSA-4vf2-m5pw-3r3r. Use v10.0.2 ONLY; v10.0.0/v10.0.1 withdrawn.

content.title: Sommelier V8: Cosmos SDK 0.47, Gravity slashing fixes, Validator incentives, fee burn
content.description: This is a proposal to upgrade the Sommelier Protocol to v8.0.1. This ugprade moves the protocol to CosmosSDK 0.47. It fixes some bugs with gravity slashing behavior, it introduces the adjustable burn of Somm tokens from the auction and introduces a mechanisms for community pool grants to reward validators.

content.title: Update Token Prices - Oct 2024
content.description: This proposal updates existing token prices to their 52 week highs, and SOMM to its 52 week low. These values are used to set the starting auction prices for fees. Denominations in the x/cellarfees module account cannot be auctioned without a fresh TokenPrice set in the x/auction module.

content.title: Introduce auction proceeds burn
content.description: Sommelier currently auctions all earned fees for somm and then distributes the earned fees to stakers. This proposal would instruct the development team to modify the cellar fees module to burn 50% of the proceeds of the auction and distribute the remaining SOMM to stakers. See https://community.sommelier.finance/t/implementing-a-deflationary-mechanism-for-somm-token/1321 for more information.
